Mochi (Levir Studio)
releases.summary: A cozy desktop companion where your time becomes part of your collection. Decorate your room, collect Steam Inventory collectibles, trade on the Steam Community Market, visit other players' cozy spaces, and grow your collection while you work or study.

releases.name: Idle Abyss Miner
releases.summary: A relaxing idle incremental game featuring automated mining, miner synergy builds, and abyss exploration. Recruit unique miners, unlock special bonuses, build your automated mining line, and defeat abyssal guardians for rare ores!

releases.name: Blob of Ink
releases.summary: Blob of Ink is a short incremental game where you grow a tiny living ink blob into something greater. Consume letters, unlock magic powers, gather ink, and evolve into your final form.

releases.name: Unbroken Valor
releases.summary: In this dark ink‑wash roguelike card game, build your 3‑person squad. Freely combine Eight‑Gua elements, 12 Blessings, treasures, talismans and mental insights. Fight and grow within endless time loops; every sword swing is a new unknown adventure.

releases.name: One More Slime
releases.summary: Rain arrows on slimes, spend the gold, do it again. A bite-sized incremental arena: 15-second runs, a 100+ node upgrade tree, 9 slime types, forge your bow at the anvil, hunt artifacts, and close the slime portal to win.

releases.name: Ride It!
releases.summary: You just wanted a drink. And the bike was right there. 3D platforming and plenty of wipeouts standing between you and that drink you deserve.

releases.name: SHIROKUMA KING
releases.summary: Give it a weapon. Protect it with a shield. Then just watch. This is an asynchronous online physics battle game where you freely place swords, guns, shields, shoes, etc. around your polar bear and battle polar bears created by other players.

releases.name: A Couple Nights At The Chud House
releases.summary: You fell asleep first at the sleepover, and now your friends aren't acting quite the same. Defend yourself from the Chuds in this point-and-click style horror game, uncover forgotten memories, and discover what's really happening.

releases.name: Box Knight
releases.summary:
The office has fallen into darkness. A 'toxic' workplace has transformed the once happy employees into dark and dangerous creatures. The office waits for a hero. You! Become the Box Knight and bring light back to this dark place.

Level by level, department by department you liberate the office of the toxic scourge that has plagued the once great company. Your end goal, battle your way up the Office tower and defeat the CEO in glorious battle or die trying...and do it all over again next week.

releases.name: The Case of the Golden Night Apartment
Apidya' Special
releases.summary:
The legendary 1992 Amiga shoot ’em up Apidya is making its long-awaited comeback. 

Developed by the original team, together with a devoted Apidya super-fan-turned-developer, Apidya’ Special is based on a previously abandoned 1990s console port, combining original assets with all-new pixel art, additional authentic sound effects, and remixed music. Legendary composer Chris Hülsbeck contributes an exclusive, completely rearranged soundtrack which has never been released.

Players can experience Apidya’ Special in true widescreen with new parallax effects or switch to the original Amiga 4:3 mode that looks, plays, and sounds exactly like 1992. Optional CRT effects with simulated shadow mask, scan lines, and phosphor bloom recreate the classic display feel.
